name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new roof installation?

mainEntity.name: What kind of warranty can I expect on a new roof installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new roof installation typically comes with two types of warranties: a manufacturer's warranty on the roofing materials and a contractor's warranty on the workmanship. Manufacturer warranties often cover defects in materials for 20 to 50 years, depending on the product. Our workmanship warranty covers the quality of the installation for a specific period, typically several years. Always clarify the terms, duration, and what specifically is covered under both warranties before signing a contract.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can expect a manufacturer's warranty on materials (20-50+ years) and a contractor's warranty on workmanship (typically several years).
